summary.text: Alexandria Butler is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 146 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Lauren Ashley Simmons.
Her career experience includes working as a minister.

paragraphs.text: Alexandria Butler was born in Kansas City, Kansas, and earned a high school diploma from Wichita High School Southeast.
Her career experience includes working as a minister, and as of 2025 she was affiliated with Urban Conservatives of America.
She won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 146 with no opposition.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner and said she is passionate about protecting families, parental rights and school choice, and supports faith-based approaches to crime, homelessness and poverty and secure borders.
